glosses: fashion (current (constantly changing) trend, favored for frivolous rather than practical, logical, or intellectual reasons)
ballad (long song that tells a story)

examples.text: Suas roupas estão fora de moda.
examples.en: Your clothes are out of fashion.

examples.text: Isso está na moda novamente, aparentemente.
Esse tipo de vestido agora está na moda.
examples.en: That kind of dress is now in fashion.
